verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs point to an official OpenAPI repository (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi) with specs for every public API, described as the single source of truth and recommended as LLM context. The probe's 404s only checked guessed paths on docs.adyen.com and do not contradict specs hosted on GitHub. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of downloading the GitHub-hosted specs, and a discoverable spec URL on the docs domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: contains OpenAPI specifications for every public API Adyen offers. These specifications are the single source of truth for our APIs
